messages:
alex: Quick PR incoming to tighten the Hello quickstart. Aim: make auth copy-pasteable, add a tiny node snippet using the new SDK import, and fix one broken deploy anchor.

tara: awesome. can you add an explicit export line for the env var? new folks often miss it.

alex: yes: `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` near the top. also adding a one-liner about required scopes for starter tokens.

mike: please keep curl first (single-line) then node. curl should be minimal so people can paste into terminal.

alex: plan for curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood/fast-qa","prompt":"Hi"}'`

alex: node snippet will be `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'; const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY }); const r = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood/fast-qa', prompt: 'Hi' }); console.log(r.text);`

tara: add a tiny troubleshooting note for CORS on first deploy and a pin-model hint for Dedicated.

docs-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4260 title: "Hello quickstart: copyable auth + SDK snippet + anchor fix" (author: alex)

mike: reviewing, will leave a couple inline comments about wording and the pin example format. aiming to approve today.
